name: key-tap-a
prompt: A single short mechanical keyboard key press, crisp plastic click with a soft release, close and dry.

name: key-tap-b
prompt: A light laptop keyboard key tap, quick muted plastic click, recorded close with no room reverb.

name: key-tap-c
prompt: A firm typewriter-style key strike, snappy mechanical clack with a brief spring ping at the end.

name: correct-letter
prompt: A small bright xylophone bar struck once with a wooden mallet, cheerful high ding with short resonance.

name: word-complete
prompt: Three ascending marimba notes played with soft mallets, warm wooden chimes rising happily and ringing out briefly.

name: round-win
prompt: A short triumphant fanfare of brass and bells, four bright rising notes ending on a held shimmering chord.

name: round-lose
prompt: A soft descending wooden flute phrase, three gentle falling notes, sympathetic and calm rather than harsh.

name: invalid-buzz
prompt: A short low electronic error buzz, dull and brief, like a game show wrong-answer tone at low volume.

name: check-mark
prompt: A single sharp pencil stroke ticking a checkbox on paper, quick scratchy tick with a paper rustle.

name: reveal-shimmer
prompt: A soft magical glissando shimmer, like a finger sweeping upward across a small wind chime or bar chimes.

name: select-tick-a
prompt: A soft UI click, like pressing a small rounded plastic button, quiet and short with a gentle attack.

name: select-tick-b
prompt: A gentle fingertip tap on a wooden board, short warm knock with no echo.
